reason: Setting a context's user agent, which stock WebKit refuses with Unsupported (emulation.userAgent), so the context can't be made and the popup's user agent can't be read
Giving a context website credentials, which stock WebKit refuses with Unsupported, so the context can't be made
Emulating touch in a context, which Chromium supports and Firefox and stock WebKit don't (emulation.touch), so the popup's touch support can't be set there
Taking a context offline, which stock WebKit refuses with Unsupported (emulation.network.offline), so the popup can't inherit it
Subscribing to a page's popups, which stock WebKit doesn't support because it doesn't say which page opened another (popups.opener), so Popup.next fails with Unsupported
Exposing a function to every page of a context, which the page calls from a popup's script; Strider has no exposeFunction
Exposing a binding to a context, which a closed popup's script calls and whose source page is reported; Strider has no exposeBinding
